_why: Filmed on the app exactly as it ships (brand guide section 8): nothing of its own interface is hidden or restyled, and the window wears Meadow Mist, the real theme the person settled on in the look conversation. The only record-time changes are story ones: the Home and $ header buttons stay hidden until the person has made those things, and the page view's content is left empty (the page's iframe made invisible) so the staged page can be composited into the real page frame. model= picks a well-known model for the picker instead of hiding it. Recorded 1960 tall so no bubble is ever half cut off at the top; the first action sets the page clock to the evening this conversation happens (look 9:12 PM, home 6:24 PM, money 9:38 PM) so the app's own message times read true instead of a frozen 8:00 AM.
